question: Should OpenClaw accept compaction results produced after safety-timeout cancellation while the wrapper's bounded timeout reason is still active?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but this is an owner-level session-state policy choice because it allows a timeout-cancelled native compaction to commit transcript state instead of treating every aborted signal as cancellation.

options.title: Accept the bounded timeout-result contract
options.body: Allow the PR to merge after owner review confirms that only the safety wrapper's live timeout reason may commit cooperative progress before timeout rejection wins.

options.title: Narrow to inner partial summaries only
options.body: Request a replacement shape that preserves chunk summaries and timeout copy but does not let AgentSession commit after timeout cancellation.

options.title: Require stronger live proof first
options.body: Pause merge until a full gateway/provider compaction run demonstrates the 180s timeout path and resulting session state in a real deployment.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded timeout-result contract
recommendation.body: Allow the PR to merge after owner review confirms that only the safety wrapper's live timeout reason may commit cooperative progress before timeout rejection wins.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to vincentkoc, and the unresolved choice is maintainer acceptance of the session-state timeout contract rather than a contributor-side code defect.
